My Signal Well (Austin, TX) | Founding Engineer | ONSITE Austin | Fractional or full-time

AI health coaching, personalized, data-driven, built on real biomarkers (DNA, wearables, labs, food logs). Product is live. Stack: Python/FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Fitbit + Apple Health integrations, LLM pipelines. Infrastructure needs modernization — no containers yet. That's where you come in.

What makes this different: we run an autonomous AI engineering team (Claude Code agents) that handles feature builds and deploys. You're not writing CRUD. You own architecture, infrastructure, and the path to scale.

First priority: containerize, CI/CD, HIPAA-compliant AWS migration.

Must have: Python, Docker in production, PostgreSQL, ops mindset. Health tech or regulated industry experience is a plus. You've built and scaled something real.
